description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing dependencies, parameter parsing, and request handling within a FastAPI application. It includes logic for extracting and validating request parameters, handling dependency injection, and managing request body data, particularly in relation to FastAPI's dependency system and Pydantic models.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: Data class holding details about a parameter's type annotation, dependencies, and associated model field for dependency analysis.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: Data class representing the results of resolving a dependency, including extracted values, errors, response, and a cache of dependency results.

methods.name: None ensure_multipart_is_installed()
methods.description: Checks if the 'python-multipart' package is installed and throws an error if not.

methods.name: Dependant get_parameterless_sub_dependant(*, depends: params.Depends, path: str)
methods.description: Creates a Dependant object for a parameterless dependency, handling security scopes.

methods.name: Dependant get_flat_dependant( dependant: Dependant, *, skip_repeats: bool = False, visited: Optional[list[DependencyCacheKey]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Flattens a nested dependency tree into a single level Dependant, accumulating path, query, header, cookie, and nested dependencies.

methods.name: list[ModelField] get_flat_params(dependant: Dependant)
methods.description: Extracts flattened list of model fields from a given Dependant, including path, query, header, and cookie parameters.

methods.name: inspect.Signature get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Returns the signature of a callable with resolved type annotations, evaluating ForwardRefs.

methods.name: Any get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Resolves a possibly string-based type annotation into an actual type, handling ForwardRefs.

methods.name: Any get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any])
methods.description: Extracts and resolves the return annotation of a callable.

methods.name: Dependant get_dependant( *, path: str, call: Callable[..., Any], name: Optional[str] = None, own_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None, use_cache: bool = True, scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object for a given path and callable, analyzing parameters for dependencies and extracting route parameters.

methods.name: None add_param_to_fields(*, field: ModelField, dependant: Dependant)
methods.description: Appends a ModelField to the appropriate list in a Dependant based on its in_ attribute.

methods.name: ParamDetails analyze_param( *, param_name: str, annotation: Any, value: Any, is_path_param: bool, )
methods.description: Analyzes a parameter's annotation and default value to determine its type, dependency, and model field configuration.

methods.name: Optional[bool] add_non_field_param_to_dependency( *, param_name: str, type_annotation: Any, dependant: Dependant )
methods.description: Detects special parameters such as Request, WebSocket, Response, and assigns them to the Dependant.

methods.name: SolvedDependency solve_dependencies( *, request: Union[Request, WebSocket], dependant: Dependant, body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]] = None, background_tasks: Optional[StarletteBackgroundTasks] = None, response: Optional[Response] = None, dependency_overrides_provider: Optional[Any] = None, dependency_cache: Optional[dict[DependencyCacheKey, Any]] = None, async_exit_stack: AsyncExitStack, embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies of a Dependant, injecting request parameters, handling nested dependencies, and managing dependency cache.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[Any]] request_params_to_args( fields: Sequence[ModelField], received_params: Union[Mapping[str, Any], QueryParams, Headers], )
methods.description: Converts incoming request parameters (query, path, headers, cookies) into a dictionary of arguments for dependency functions.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[dict[str,Any]]] request_body_to_args( body_fields: list[ModelField], received_body: Optional[Union[dict[str, Any], FormData]], embed_body_fields: bool, )
methods.description: Parses and validates the request body according to the defined ModelFields, supporting multiple media types like JSON, form, and files.

methods.name: Optional[ModelField] get_body_field( *, flat_dependant: Dependant, name: str, embed_body_fields: bool )
methods.description: Generates a combined ModelField representing the request body for an operation, optionally embedding multiple fields into a single model.
